After toggling ZoomIt you can zoom in with the mouse wheel or up and down arrow keys. Exit zoom mode with Escape or by pressing the right mouse button.
Specify the initial level of magnification when zooming in:
Animate zoom in and zoom out:
Copy a zoomed screen with Ctrl+C or save it by typing Ctrl+S. Crop the copy or save region by entering Ctrl+Shift instead of Ctrl.

Once zoomed, toggle drawing mode by pressing the left mouse button. Undo with Ctrl+Z and all drawing by pressing E. Center the cursor with the space bar. Exit drawing mode by pressing the right mouse button.
Change the pen width by pressing left Ctrl and using the mouse wheel or the up and down arrow keys.
Change the pen color by pressing R (red), G (green), B (blue),
O (orange), Y (yellow), P (pink), W (white) or K (black).
Hold Shift while pressing a color key for a translucent highlighter color. Press X for blur or Shift+X for a stronger blur.
Draw a line by holding down the Shift key, a rectangle with the Ctrl key, an ellipse with the Tab key and an arrow with Shift+Ctrl.

Clear the screen for a sketch pad by pressing Ctrl+W (white) or Ctrl+K (black). Copy a zoomed screen with Ctrl+C or save it by typing Ctrl+S. Crop the copy or save region by entering Ctrl+Shift instead of Ctrl.

Once in drawing mode, type 't' to enter typing mode or shift+'t' to enter typing mode with right-aligned input. Exit typing mode by pressing escape or the left mouse button. Use the mouse wheel or up and down arrow keys to change the font size.
The text color is the current drawing color.

Enter timer mode by using the ZoomIt tray icon's Break menu item. Increase and decrease time with the arrow keys. If you Alt-Tab away from the timer window, reactivate it by left-clicking on the ZoomIt tray icon. Exit timer mode with Escape.
Change the break timer color using the same keys that the drawing color, including background color. The break timer font is the same as text font.
LiveZoom mode is supported on Windows 7 and higher where window updates show while zoomed.
To enter and exit LiveZoom, enter the hotkey specified below.

Use LiveDraw to draw and annotate the live desktop. To activate LiveDraw, enter the hotkey with the Shift key in the opposite mode. You can remove LiveDraw annotations by activating LiveDraw and enter the escape key
Note that in LiveZoom you must use Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down to control the zoom level. To enter drawing mode, use the standard zoom-without-draw hotkey and then escape to go back to LiveZoom.
Record video of the unzoomed live screen or a static zoomed session by entering the recording hot key and finish the recording by entering it again.
To crop the portion of the screen that will be recorded, enter the hotkey with the Shift key in the opposite mode.
To record a specific window, enter the hotkey with the Alt key in the opposite mode.
Copy a region of the screen to the clipboard or enter the hotkey with the Shift key in the opposite mode to save it to a file.
Copy text from the selected region to the clipboard:

Capture a scrolling panorama of a selected screen region. Select the area, then scroll the content. Move slowly and consistently, and do not rewind to previously covered areas. Press the hotkey again or with Shift to save to a file.
For the best results, scroll slowly and at a constant rate, do not include stationary content (like scrollbars) in the capture area, and avoid content that is changing (e.g., animations or videos).
When you reach the end of the file, ZoomIt will reload the file and start at the beginning. Enter the hotkey with the Shift key in the opposite mode to step back to the last [end].

DemoType has ZoomIt type text specified in the input file when you enter the DemoType toggle. Simply separate snippets with the [end] keyword, or you can insert text from the clipboard if it is prefixed with the [start].
- Insert pauses with the [pause:n] keyword where 'n' is seconds.
You can have ZoomIt send text automatically, or select the option to drive input with typing. ZoomIt will block keyboard input while sending output.
When driving input, hit the space bar to unblock keyboard input at the end of a snippet. In auto mode, control will be returned upon completion.
- Send text via the clipboard with [paste] and [/paste].
